title: Motilli — The Anniversary He Thought She Forgot
summary: An anniversary dinner looks like a relationship crisis until Linda tells Tom what she has been hiding. Their private conversation changes the meaning of the same action at the next date night. 20 original 3D animated portrait scene images; exact approved script v1; approximately 2:01 with provisional timing. Read left to right across each act, then down.

timelines.label: ACT 1 — The interrupted evening
timelines.source: OUR VERSION · Approved script v1 · Proposed timing, not voice-aligned

beats.script:
TOM: Thirty-two years, and you still—
LINDA: Tom. I’m sorry. I can’t do this.
beats.visual: Low table-level wide: Linda pushes back her chair, startled and distressed, one hand at her abdomen. Tom lunges to catch her tipping glass; candle and anniversary dinner in foreground.
beats.emotion: Shock and curiosity; her interruption opens the relationship mystery.
beats.note:
CUT: Catch the glass and cut on her departure.
WHY HERE: Start with a charged interruption. Open the apparent relationship crisis before revealing the physical problem.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: TOM: I hadn’t even started the speech.
beats.visual: Medium Tom behind the abandoned place setting; Linda disappears into the hallway in deep background. His raised toast slowly drops.
beats.emotion: Tender wounded humor; the empty chair makes the cost visible.
beats.note:
CUT: Hold after speech, bridge footsteps into hallway.
WHY HERE: A small, wounded joke establishes his personality and keeps the opening from feeling melodramatic.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: TOM: Linda? Have I done something?
beats.visual: Profile medium of Tom stopped beside the closed bathroom door, hand hovering before a knock.
beats.emotion: Uncertainty; he voices the viewer’s question at the physical barrier.
beats.note:
CUT: Cut across the closed door after his question.
WHY HERE: Voice the viewer’s question and establish that this has happened before.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script:
LINDA: No.
TOM: Then why do you keep leaving?
beats.visual: Bathroom medium: Linda in her anniversary dress sits fully clothed on the closed toilet lid, clutching a tissue, looking toward the door.
beats.emotion: Private embarrassment; show the person hidden behind the apparent rejection.
beats.note:
CUT: Her No is on camera; his next question continues off screen. Hold then cut closer.
WHY HERE: Voice the viewer’s question and establish that this has happened before.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: LINDA: Because I’m bloated all the time. I can barely go to the bathroom. Since I started the shot, every dinner feels like a gamble.
beats.visual: Intimate seated Linda close-up, one tissue just below her wet eye, shoulders tense; cool bathroom shadows.
beats.emotion: Recognition and empathy; stay with the difficult admission without comic symptom imagery.
beats.note:
CUT: Slow restrained push during admission; cut on Tom’s question.
WHY HERE: Pay off the opening mystery with a private fact. Her dress carries the conflict between the evening she wanted and the evening she is having.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

timelines.label: ACT 2 — What she was hiding
timelines.source: OUR VERSION · Approved script v1 · Proposed timing, not voice-aligned

beats.script: TOM: Why didn’t you tell me?
beats.visual: Tight Tom reaction by door, brows relaxing, his hand falls away from the door.
beats.emotion: Reinterpretation; concern replaces his belief that she is rejecting him.
beats.note:
CUT: Direct cut on the question to mirror reflection.
WHY HERE: Pay off the opening mystery with a private fact. Her dress carries the conflict between the evening she wanted and the evening she is having.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: LINDA: I wanted you to look at me in this dress. Not picture me stuck in here.
beats.visual: Over Linda’s shoulder into an oval bathroom mirror; her gold teardrop earring catches the warm vanity light as she touches it.
beats.emotion: Tenderness; the carefully chosen earring reveals how much this evening mattered.
beats.note:
CUT: Hold reflection through her line; cut to Tom for his admission.
WHY HERE: Explain the secrecy and show the personal cost. The earrings establish that she remembered and cared.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: TOM: I thought you didn’t want our evenings anymore.
beats.visual: Hallway medium front angle of Tom, lower gaze, thumb rubbing wedding ring, bathroom door at frame edge.
beats.emotion: Mutual vulnerability; give his mistaken interpretation its own reaction space.
beats.note:
CUT: Door latch sound motivates the next cut.
WHY HERE: Explain the secrecy and show the personal cost. The earrings establish that she remembered and cared.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script:
LINDA: I wanted to lose the weight. I didn’t want to lose our evenings.
TOM: Then let’s stop pretending you’re fine.
beats.visual: Doorway two-shot: Linda opens the door and faces Tom; he steps closer gently, both now sharing the frame.
beats.emotion: Reconnection; remove the literal barrier before the key belief change.
beats.note:
CUT: Hold their shared frame; 0.5s dissolve to daylight, counted within transition budget.
WHY HERE: State the desired identity and emotional objective before any product. His response changes the next action from concealment to support.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: [Silent action / music]
beats.visual: Morning kitchen wide: Linda in a sage cardigan lowers her phone after a call at the sunlit window and turns toward Tom seated at the oak table.
beats.emotion: Agency; establish that she sought professional help before discussing a personal routine.
beats.note:
CUT: Silent establishing action; direct cut when she joins him.
WHY HERE: Introduce a supported explanation and undo the assumption that symptoms must be hidden. The prescriber is not shown endorsing a supplement.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

timelines.label: ACT 3 — Asking for help, choosing a routine
timelines.source: OUR VERSION · Approved script v1 · Proposed timing, not voice-aligned

beats.script: LINDA: I finally called. My medication can slow how fast food leaves my stomach. Bloating and constipation can be side effects.
beats.visual: Linda medium across breakfast table, phone face down beside her, explaining calmly with an open hand.
beats.emotion: Understanding; her face carries the explanation, with no supplement or invented medical diagram.
beats.note:
CUT: Direct cut to shared frame on Tom’s reply.
WHY HERE: Introduce a supported explanation and undo the assumption that symptoms must be hidden. The prescriber is not shown endorsing a supplement.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script:
TOM: And you thought you just had to live with it?
LINDA: I thought I wasn’t supposed to complain.
beats.visual: Side two-shot at breakfast: Tom leans in listening while Linda looks down at her folded hands.
beats.emotion: Permission to speak; exchange exposes the belief that she should not complain.
beats.note:
CUT: Pause after her last word; cut closer to supportive gesture.
WHY HERE: Introduce a supported explanation and undo the assumption that symptoms must be hidden. The prescriber is not shown endorsing a supplement.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: TOM: You can be happy about your progress and still ask for help.
beats.visual: Low close two-shot with coffee in foreground: Tom slides her mug toward her as he sits beside her, Linda looks up.
beats.emotion: Reassurance; a small familiar action makes support believable.
beats.note:
CUT: Hold shared frame, then 0.4s dissolve signaling a later routine.
WHY HERE: Resolve the belief that gratitude for progress means accepting every difficulty silently.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script:
TOM: What’s that?
LINDA: Motilli. Celery juice gummies. I wanted something simple to add to my daily routine.
beats.visual: Product-led close view of Linda’s hand setting the exact Motilli jar beside a clear water glass on the kitchen counter, her torso behind it.
beats.emotion: Practical curiosity; name the format and let her choose it for her routine.
beats.note:
CUT: Bottle settles exactly on Motilli; cut back to Linda for the joke.
WHY HERE: Make product choice hers. Introduce the concrete format and its practical appeal without claiming it reverses medication effects.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script:
TOM: Gummies?
LINDA: You know how I feel about swallowing pills.
beats.visual: Medium Linda at counter giving Tom an affectionate wry smile, one raised eyebrow; jar remains softly visible in the foreground.
beats.emotion: Personality and ease; the gummy preference is hers, without an efficacy promise.
beats.note:
CUT: Hold smile; 0.5s dissolve to a clearly later candlelit evening.
WHY HERE: Make product choice hers. Introduce the concrete format and its practical appeal without claiming it reverses medication effects.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

timelines.label: ACT 4 — The same gesture, a new meaning
timelines.source: OUR VERSION · Approved script v1 · Proposed timing, not voice-aligned

beats.script: TOM: Linda?
beats.visual: Later candlelit dinner from a different reverse angle: Linda rises, Tom briefly freezes with concern; same teal dress and gold earrings.
beats.emotion: Brief suspense; revive the opening question as a deliberate callback.
beats.note:
CUT: Cut on her reassuring turn toward music.
WHY HERE: Repeat the opening action with a new meaning. Close the relationship loop through communication and connection, not a claim that a gummy produced immediate relief.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script:
LINDA: I’m turning the music up.
TOM: I still have a speech.
beats.visual: Linda by a small wooden tabletop radio, turning its volume knob and looking back warmly toward Tom in the room.
beats.emotion: Relief and playful reversal; show the true reason for standing up.
beats.note:
CUT: Music comes up; Tom’s speech line off screen bridges into her invitation.
WHY HERE: Repeat the opening action with a new meaning. Close the relationship loop through communication and connection, not a claim that a gummy produced immediate relief.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: LINDA: You can tell me while we dance.
beats.visual: Close view of Linda reaching her open hand toward Tom, his hand starting to meet hers, smiling faces softly in background.
beats.emotion: Invitation; the hand closes the emotional distance created by the first scene.
beats.note:
CUT: Cut on their hands meeting into the first dance step.
WHY HERE: Repeat the opening action with a new meaning. Close the relationship loop through communication and connection, not a claim that a gummy produced immediate relief.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: [Silent action / music]
beats.visual: Kitchen full-body two-shot of the couple beginning an awkward gentle dance, candlelit dining table visible through the doorway.
beats.emotion: Warm payoff; the evening and relationship return to the center of the story.
beats.note:
CUT: Silent dance and music for 3s; clean cut to pack for full VO.
WHY HERE: Leave the viewer with the relationship payoff and a clear brand invitation.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

beats.script: VOICEOVER: A little care for your everyday. Meet Motilli.
beats.visual: Standalone exact Motilli jar hero on warm cream surface with soft sage background. Clean large end-card typography: Motilli Celery Juice Gummies and getmotilli.com.
beats.emotion: Brand recognition and clear next step; let the pack and URL remain readable.
beats.note:
CUT: End hold minimum 3s; extend if performed VO needs it.
WHY HERE: Leave the viewer with the relationship payoff and a clear brand invitation.
STYLE: Expressive adult character acting in one continuous, softly lit 3D domestic world.

notes.title: PERFORMANCE & SOUND
notes.text: Linda: embarrassed → candid → playful. Tom: wounded dry humor → concern → reassurance. Leave the admission unhurried. Glass catch and chair scrape at opening; footsteps and latch connect rooms. Score quieter beneath the private admission. Radio music becomes the dance cue. Final timing follows the performed dialogue.

notes.title: CONTINUITY & CUTS
notes.text: Same silver-haired couple throughout. Teal dress, gold earrings and navy cardigan return at the later dinner. Sage and oatmeal morning wardrobe marks time passing. Direct cuts follow questions, reactions and gestures; gentle dissolves only mark later days. Closed door stays closed until the shared doorway shot.

notes.title: PRODUCT & FINISH
notes.text: Product first appears at 1:30, after prescriber contact and emotional reconnection. Jar follows the supplied brand reference. Fictional story, no doctor endorsement or instant symptom-cure effect. End card uses the approved URL. Readable phrase captions will be aligned after voice recording; no captions are baked into scene images.

notes.title: STORYBOARD SCOPE
notes.text: Selected first-frame images and editorial direction for every shot. These are stills, not generated video. Google Omni is the planned motion route and DaVinci Resolve the editor. 9:16 composition; final 1080×1920 delivery, lip sync, duration, subtitle timing and audio mix need production QA.
